title: Resolve Admin-managed checkout delivery options
verify: The backend reads delivery configuration from Medusa Admin / Shipping Options rather than a parallel tariff registry or hardcoded runtime fallback.
The projected options use stable IDs pickup, city_courier, and transport_company in that order and expose initial local tariffs 0 RUB, 500 RUB, and 700 RUB.
Unavailable configured options are represented so the validation boundary can return delivery_method_unavailable without silently substituting another option.
Currency and money representation remain compatible with the installed Medusa v2.16 source and no external carrier calculation is added.

verify.reason: Operator approved the bounded scope expansion required to register the built-in manual fulfillment provider and rerun the required integration gate.
verify.operator_approval: User approval received in the current orchestrator session.

evidence_required: Sanitized Admin / Shipping Options source and option-order output.
Synthetic local tariff projection showing 0/500/700 RUB.
Backend typecheck, integration, and Memory Bank lint output.
constraints: Medusa Admin / Shipping Options is the only tariff and availability source.
Use stable IDs and order pickup, city_courier, transport_company with initial local values 0/500/700 RUB.
Do not add external delivery-provider calculation, a custom tariff registry, or Medusa Core changes.
Stop if the installed Medusa v2.16 boundary cannot expose configured options without a parallel source.
invariants: A missing or unavailable option is never silently replaced by a hardcoded tariff.
Delivery option order is deterministic: pickup, city_courier, transport_company.
FT-006 does not create orders, reservations, payment attempts, or provider state.
purpose: Establish one backend projection over the Admin-managed delivery options and initial local tariffs for all later FT-006 slices.
success_outcome: The installed Medusa runtime exposes the three stable delivery options in deterministic order with configured 0/500/700 RUB local values and explicit availability.
anti_goals: Do not implement checkout field validation or storefront UI.
Do not create an order, inventory reservation, payment attempt, or external delivery integration.
Do not hardcode runtime tariffs as a fallback when Admin / Shipping Options is unavailable.

stop_conditions: The installed Medusa v2.16 boundary cannot expose Admin / Shipping Options values and availability.
Correct behavior requires a parallel hardcoded tariff source.
Money or currency semantics cannot be represented without inventing a new public contract.
